key_insight: DeepDOSReasoner predicts electronic and phonon density-of-states spectra from crystal structures while enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation.
engineering_relevance: Millisecond-scale spectral predictions could accelerate materials screening, including photovoltaic chalcogenides, but do not directly predict solar-cell efficiency.
method: Decode spectra using atom-to-energy source attention.
Refine normalized spectra through learned continuity-equation transport.
Preserve nonnegativity and total spectral weight by construction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports best accuracy across evaluated metrics and a prospective screen of 8,106 materials, with new DFT calculations confirming valence-band gaps in 25 of the model’s top 50 candidates.
watch_item: DFT-validated spectral accuracy and valence-band-gap discovery do not establish experimental photovoltaic performance.
paper_title: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
